description: Use before sending funds or when you only have a human-readable name: resolves ENS names (.eth and DNS names on ENS, including offchain/wildcard resolvers via CCIP-Read such as *.cb.id) and Basenames (*.base.eth, read directly on Base) to a checksummed address; or, given an address, returns its primary ENS name and primary Basename, each forward-verified (the name must resolve back to the address). Names are normalized per ENSIP-15. Unresolvable names are not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

address.description: Address to reverse-resolve (0x… 40 hex). Give name or address.

name.description: ENS name or Basename to resolve, e.g. vitalik.eth or jesse.base.eth. Give name or address.
